title: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as…
description: LibreOffice includes the HSQLDB database engine, which allows SQL statements to invoke Java methods. A vulnerability exists when HSQLDB is accessed via the generic JDBC driver, as it does not restrict which Java classes can be called. This allows a crafted document to execute arbitrary Java code. Fixed versions restrict SQL calls to only built-in HSQLDB functions regardless of access method.
